question: Explain why a charged plastic comb attracts small pieces of paper even though the paper pieces are initially neutral.

options.A: The comb induces charge separation in neutral paper; opposite charge on the nearer side experiences stronger attraction than the repulsion from the farther like charge
options.B: The paper pieces become permanently charged with the same sign as the comb before any interaction
options.C: The comb transfers electrons to the paper pieces without touching them
options.D: Neutral paper cannot experience any electrostatic force
